rationale: After breaking above the initial $54.52 target to a high of $54.86, EQT has lost upward momentum and slipped just below its 5-minute 9-EMA ($54.72) on the highest 1-minute down-volume of the recent consolidation. With the current stop still fixed back at $53.98, holding exposes $76.92 of open profit and $52.49 of principal to a late-day pullback when the remaining daily loss budget is tight ($236.22). Closing now locks in the majority of the move with 53 minutes left in the session rather than risking a deeper retracement toward VWAP.
